summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Rahm Mum on LIV Future
items.text: Jon Rahm said “we’ll see” about his LIV Golf future while returning to the Irish Open at Trump International Doonbeg, where he's pursuing his third title amid LIV's uncertainty.

items.headline: Jason Day Declines Presidents Cup Role
items.text: Jason Day turned down a vice-captain position at the Presidents Cup to focus on rehabbing a back injury, leaving the International team short of one of its recent stars.
